legacy_integration.title: Remove the old EAN Reader integration
legacy_integration.description: Shopping Assistant replaces EAN Reader and has imported its products. Delete the EAN Reader entry under Settings > Devices & services, then remove the custom_components/ean_reader folder and restart Home Assistant.
